cases.title: registration is refused without agreement acceptance, and the refusal names the agreement

evidence.message: Acceptance of "Safety InSite — Internal / Pre-Beta Use Acknowledgement" (internal-pre-beta-acknowledgement v2026-09-14.1) is required.

cases.title: a participant who has never existed registers with no operator involvement
the new participant can sign in immediately, with no activation step
a new account starts with NO entitlement and NO subscription, and says so
the participant creates their own first site; no site is pre-created for them
the participant creates their own first inspection
the participant records an observation against that inspection
an ordinary participant cannot grant themselves an entitlement
an ordinary participant cannot revoke an entitlement either
a configured promo code confers Pro through a BOUNDED grant, with no database change
the comped account carries NO subscription, so nothing may present it as a purchase
/login — the email field is type=email (O-14)
signed out, every authenticated route renders something honest — no blank page, no stuck loading state, no raw server error, no privileged content
and every one of them offers a way out
signed in, every critical route survives direct navigation and a browser refresh
and none of it produced a 5xx
an expired session never renders an unqualified zero — every stale figure says what kind of figure it is
and the dead session is cleared rather than kept
so the next navigation lands on sign-in
/inspections — the START card's heading and its controls share one left edge (O-4)
/inspections — no workflow description is clipped mid-sentence (O-5)
/inspections — no engineering vocabulary on the customer surface (O-7)
/inspections — the regulatory footnote states one context once (O-6)
/settings — no raw subscription status code on the customer surface (O-10)
/settings — no internal vendor named to the customer (O-11)
an Expert request that cannot run is refused BEFORE any provider is reached
and the refusal is worded for the inspector, not for a log

evidence.message: Expert analysis is temporarily unavailable. Your deterministic HazLenz analysis is unaffected and this observation can still be reviewed, finalized and reported. No analysis was run and nothing was charged.

cases.title: a comped Pro participant is offered the Pro workflow rather than an upgrade wall
a refused Expert run is VISIBLE to the inspector, and survives the reconciling read that follows it
the reviewer can save a finding
an inspection saved in one session can be FINISHED in another, and produces its report
